context_files.purpose: Fresh scientific interpretation and its scoring ambiguities.
Fresh systems interpretation and its visibility parser and lifecycle concerns.

strongest_case: The two-root sixteen-key matched-complement design remains the highest-information next writer scout. It directly asks whether several state-specific endpoint policies coexist after Cell F showed broad frame habits, using only four central fits and a deliberately narrow claim. V3 materially improved source pairing, workload closure, clustering, spill precedence, visibility roles, and capability fencing, so the remaining concerns are finite reducer and lifecycle definitions rather than a change to the scientific core.

concerns.statement: The optimization-NLL and spill-TV gates still permit multiple conventional reductions of identical finite likelihood tables.
concerns.evidence: Both interpretations independently identify the missing median-of-paired-differences convention, adapter-pair aggregation, adapter-versus-OFF TV contrast, and prompt-to-family reducer; the systems review also requires a lightweight fixed numeric convention.

concerns.statement: The post-commit visibility cell forbids direct map visibility while the explicit-map oracle necessarily renders a map to the frozen model.
concerns.evidence: Treating all post-commit evaluation as one principal either makes the oracle impossible or leaks oracle map bytes into ordinary held generation.

concerns.statement: Raw-byte parsing transport truncation source DONE rules flood-panel scope and required interface conditions are not fully enumerated.
concerns.evidence: Identical transcripts can be classified differently under LF versus CRLF purported-marker and fitted-versus-OFF interpretations; making all OFF interface tasks mandatory would turn the baseline into an unintended pass prerequisite.

concerns.statement: An early source fit commit hash receipt or evaluation failure cannot always yield the mandated ordered pair of scientific root labels.
concerns.evidence: Inventing a scientific label for an unrun root would misclassify infrastructure failure while continuing after a stop condition would violate the declared lifecycle.

concerns.statement: The exhaustive order statistic should not be named like a population confidence bound and spill generation must explicitly share replicate seeds across conditions.
concerns.evidence: Four deterministically selected tool clusters per stratum support a fixed-panel stability statistic only; condition-specific random draws could otherwise confound generated spill differences.
